description.value: Tacofino is a BC-born West Coast beach food chain with roots in Tofino, now operating multiple Lower Mainland locations including this White Rock outpost on Johnston Road. The restaurant serves Mexican-inspired fare with a casual, coastal vibe well suited to a post-ride meal. Pickup and third-party delivery options make it easy to grab food quickly and get back on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tacofino website confirms the White Rock location at 1405 Johnston Rd with the matching email whiterock@tacofino.com, confirming the business is real and open. The website's /locations page lists 'Order for Pickup' alongside Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and Doordash for White Rock, confirming takeout availability. No website evidence supports bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or dietary options; OSM diet tags are not treated as authoritative per the rules.
concerns: OSM phone +1-672-896-2480 is not listed for the White Rock location on the website and could not be confirmed; the website shows no phone number for this branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed by the brand's own website listing the White Rock location with matching address and email. Useful stop for touring cyclists on the Semiahmoo area routes.

wow_evidence: BC-born West Coast beach food chain with roots in Tofino, now operating multiple Lower Mainland locations
